title: Going on foot or by vehicle
description: Iść or jechać, chodzić or jeździć: Polish verbs of motion.

blocks.text: Polish distinguishes going on foot from going by vehicle. Iść means to go on foot, now or in one direction; chodzić means to go on foot regularly or there and back. Jechać means to go by car, bus, train or bike, now or in one direction; jeździć means to travel that way regularly. The vehicle is in the instrumental case: pociągiem (by train), autobusem (by bus), rowerem (by bike).

blocks.translation: I go to the swimming pool on Wednesdays.
I am going to Gdańsk by train.
We are going on holiday by car.

lines.speaker: Zosia
lines.translation: How do you get to work?

lines.speaker: Michał
lines.text: Zwykle jeżdżę tramwajem, ale dzisiaj idę pieszo.
lines.translation: I usually go by tram, but today I am walking.
